forClients.title: How can ARSAN help?
forClients.intro: Whether you are hiring a critical leader, building an operation in Mexico or navigating organizational change, ARSAN brings senior judgment and manufacturing context to the decisions that matter.

cards.title: Executive & Professional Search
cards.body: When the role is too important for a résumé-driven search. We identify and secure leaders and critical professionals who can lead, operate and deliver in the environment they are entering.

cards.title: Mexico Expansion & Workforce Advisory
cards.body: For companies entering, launching or expanding operations in Mexico. Build the organization before the operation depends on it.

cards.title: Enterprise Talent & Leadership Solutions
cards.body: Support the people already inside the business when something important is changing — leadership development, transitions and complex organizational needs.

executiveSearch.title: The right hire changes more than a position.
executiveSearch.intro: ARSAN helps manufacturers identify and secure executives and critical professionals who can lead, operate and deliver in the environment they are entering — not simply match a job description.

points.title: Understand the mandate
points.body: We begin by aligning on the real business challenge, success outcomes and non-negotiables. Clarity up front leads to better decisions later.

points.title: Know the market
points.body: We map the right talent — active and passive — across industries and borders to understand who can make an impact.

points.title: Protect the decision
points.body: We evaluate with rigor, manage risk and advise with candor so you can move forward with confidence.

mexicoAdvisory.title: Your Mexico operation starts long before production does.
mexicoAdvisory.intro: ARSAN helps manufacturers translate business strategy into the leadership, workforce and organizational foundation required to operate successfully in Mexico.

points.title: Where will the talent come from?
points.body: Understand the local labor market, skills availability and realistic pipeline.

points.title: Who should build it?
points.body: Identify the leaders who will launch, lead and develop the Mexico team.

points.title: How will two operating cultures work as one?
points.body: Build alignment across expectations, decision-making and ways of working.

leadershipSolutions.title: Strengthen the team you already have.
leadershipSolutions.intro: Leadership development, executive transitions and organizational alignment for manufacturers navigating growth and change.

points.title: Leadership team effectiveness
points.body: Align leadership teams around strategy, accountability and ways of working.

points.title: Executive coaching & mentorship
points.body: One-on-one support for leaders stepping into bigger mandates.

points.title: Organizational transitions
points.body: Steady the organization through mergers, expansions and leadership change.

forCandidates.title: Your career deserves thoughtful representation.
forCandidates.intro: Career moves are meaningful. We take the time to understand your experience, priorities and potential — then connect you with opportunities where you can lead, grow and make real impact.

points.title: Confidential
points.body: Your privacy is our priority at every step of the process.

points.title: Selective
points.body: We represent you for roles that genuinely fit — not everything that's open.

points.title: Personal
points.body: You work with senior advisors who understand manufacturing careers on both sides of the border.

whyArsan.title: We've sat on your side of the table.
whyArsan.intro: We understand your business because we've led it. That perspective drives better conversations — and better results.

difference.heading: Our Difference
difference.body: Deep manufacturing expertise in the U.S., Mexico and cross-border. Access to senior talent others cannot reach. A disciplined process that protects your time and your decision.

people.heading: Our People
people.body: Senior advisors with real operating experience in HR, manufacturing and organizational leadership across the U.S. and Mexico.

howWeWork.heading: How We Work
howWeWork.body: Collaborative and tailored. We start with the business challenge, align on what success looks like and stay close to the work from first conversation to placement.

contact.title: Tell us what you're working through.
contact.intro: Start with the business challenge. We'll help you determine whether — and how — ARSAN can help.

items.quote: They understood the operating reality of our plants before proposing a single name. The finalist slate was small, and every person on it was credible.
items.name: Operations Executive

items.quote: We were building in Mexico for the first time. ARSAN pushed us to define the organization before the org chart — that advice alone paid for the search.
items.name: General Manager

items.quote: The process respected my time. Honest about the role, honest about the risks, and available at every step.
items.name: Placed Candidate

items.quote: They told us a hire we wanted to make was the wrong one — and they were right. That candor is why we keep coming back.
items.name: VP Human Resources

items.quote: Cross-border searches usually mean two firms and two stories. With ARSAN it was one team on both sides of the border.
items.name: Chief Operating Officer

items.quote: From first call to signed offer in nine weeks, without ever feeling rushed. The preparation before each interview was exceptional.
